summary: V5 full-stack testing. Found + FIXED 1 critical backend bug: POST /api/passwords was not persisting the new `phone` field (PasswordEntryCreate model had phone, but create_password handler omitted it from the inserted doc). After fix, 19/19 V5 pytest + 21/21 V4 + 34/34 legacy = 74/74 pytest pass. Frontend UI verified end-to-end: Categories 2-tab design (Subscription Categories 7 / Leave Types 5) with + New contextual button; Profile has Personal Info + Emergency Contact cards with all 6 new fields and PATCH persists; Password Manager New Credential modal has Phone Number input between Username and Category, phone saved + returned; Calendar exposes Day/Week/Month/Year/Employee switcher (all render); /leaves has filter bar (search + type + status + from/to dates) on every tab and Admin-only 'By Employee' tab with employee dropdown + balance panel; sidebar has no standalone Leave Types item; /leave-types legacy route redirects User to /dashboard. User (Bablu) sees only 'My Leaves' tab — no Pending/All/By Employee. Hierarchical supervisor chain verified: A (Mgr) -> B (Mgr) -> C (User) — A can see C's pending leave via scope=pending, A can approve C's leave (transitive), a random unrelated Manager gets 403 on approve.

issues: React hydration warning persists: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Carry-over from V4 emergent dev wrapper injecting x-source spans inside <option>. Cosmetic dev-only.

action_items: No action items required — V5 is green after the POST /passwords phone-persistence fix I applied. Main agent may simply verify fix on their side by creating a new Password entry with phone in the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1406 lines — previously flagged split threshold (700) still ignored across V3/V4/V5. Strongly recommend modularizing to routes/passwords.py, routes/leaves.py, routes/employee_portal.py.

PasswordEntryCreate handler (line ~791) was manually mapping fields instead of `doc = {**data.model_dump(), ...}` which caused the `phone` omission bug. Prefer model_dump() with explicit overrides for encrypted_password/owner_id to prevent future missed fields (email, tags, etc).
_downstream_user_ids runs up to 10 recursive BFS iterations with one DB query per depth — fine for small orgs but consider caching per-request if list_leaves is called hot-path.

scope=pending for non-TOP_ROLES now queries `user_id: {$in: [...downstream, uid]}` — this means a Manager also sees their OWN pending leave in 'pending approvals' list, which is arguably wrong (self-approval surface). Review whether you want to exclude uid from the list.
user_leave_balance correctly restricts non-admin to downstream, but the helper builds the entire downstream set for every call; cache if this endpoint is hit often.
ProfileUpdate accepts arbitrary string for date_of_birth/phone/blood_group — no format validation. Add Pydantic regex for phone (e.g. ^[+0-9 ]{7,15}$) and date parse for DOB.
Notification fan-out in apply_leave still iterates TOP_ROLES users with individual insert_one — flagged in V4 and not addressed. insert_many would be 1 round-trip.
DELETE /api/users cascade: verify what happens to leaves/notifications owned by a deleted user — currently tests create/delete users but don't assert orphan leaves are cleaned.

/app/backend/tests/test_v5_updates.py (NEW — 19 tests covering profile fields, password phone, user leave-balance RBAC, hierarchical approval chain, leave-type CRUD, categories)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of V5 flows verified (Categories 2-tab, Profile new fields, Password phone modal, Calendar 5 views, Leaves filter bar + By Employee tab, sidebar cleanup, User restriction to My Leaves only, /leave-types redirect)

seed_data_creation: All V5 test data prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up (users A/B/C + random manager deleted after chain test; TEST_Platform password entry deleted; TEST_LT leave type deactivated). Bablu profile now has TEST_ prefixed phone/DOB/address/emergency_contact values persisted — main agent should reset Bablu profile if desired for demo cleanliness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V5 is fully green after a one-line backend fix (POST /passwords now includes phone). Test file /app/backend/tests/test_v5_updates.py is the authoritative V5 regression suite with 19 tests covering: profile new fields, password phone persistence, user leave-balance RBAC (admin bypass + user 403 for non-downstream), hierarchical supervisor chain (A -> B -> C with A able to approve transitively and random manager rejected), leave-type + categories CRUD. Frontend: Categories 2-tab, Profile Personal Info + Emergency Contact, Password modal phone, Calendar 5 views, Leaves filter bar + By Employee tab, sidebar cleanup, user restriction — all verified visually via Playwright screenshots.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/passwords phone omission — PasswordEntryCreate pydantic model had `phone: Optional[str] = None` added per V5 spec, but the create_password endpoint built the DB doc manually via `doc = { 'platform_name': ..., 'url': ..., 'username': ..., 'encrypted_password': ..., ... }` and simply forgot the phone key. PUT handler used a generic loop and worked. Fix: added `"phone": data.phone,` line after username. Verified via pytest test_create_with_phone + test_list_returns_phone_no_password (both now pass).
